skill_name: Write a horror story that focuses on the fear of technology.
workflow: It was a dark and stormy night as Sarah walked through the deserted streets. She had heard countless stories of the dangers lurking in the shadows, but never had she felt such a deep sense of dread before. Suddenly, she heard a soft electronic hum coming from the alleyway ahead. As she cautiously peered down the alley, she saw an old TV set flickering with static.
